superiority_reason: Synthetic custom likelihood-informed track, one generation; no global-best/equal-research-effort claim
description: Metropolis-corrected Hamiltonian Monte Carlo samples each observation’s separate joint posterior using the full supplied precision matrix. Four chains per observation use MAP curvature, covariance adaptation, and step-size tuning toward 90% acceptance during 950 warm-up transitions, followed by 100 fixed-tuning burn-in transitions. Three transitions separate retained draws; all sampling is seeded.
